related_questions.question: What state has the cheapest tobacco?

text_blocks.snippet: Missouri has the cheapest tobacco, specifically cigarettes, due to the lowest state excise tax rate in the United States. A pack of cigarettes in Missouri costs around $6.11 on average. Georgia and North Dakota also have relatively low cigarette prices.
